name: Natan
author: Victor Seremet (LibriVox) - public domain

description: Russian male voice for Voxprint. Trained only from the public-domain LibriVox recording 'Detstvo (Childhood)' by Leo Tolstoy, version 2, read by Victor Seremet (https://librivox.org/childhood-2-by-leo-tolstoy/). CC0-1.0, free for any use, also commercial. Attribution appreciated. The name Natan is Voxprint's own and does not imply the reader's endorsement.
